description: This Java source file defines the MidiEventThread class, which extends MidiEventScheduler and manages MIDI events in a separate thread. It contains an inner class EventThread that handles event processing and dispatching MIDI events via MidiDispatcher.
external_methods: MidiDispatcher.send(byte[] data, int offset, int count, long timestamp)

classes.name: MidiEventThread
classes.description: Manages MIDI event scheduling on a dedicated thread, providing start/stop control and access to the MidiSender.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread, responsible for waiting for MIDI events and dispatching them while the thread is active.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the EventThread, stopping it first if it is already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Requests the EventThread to stop and waits for its termination.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the MidiSender obtained from the MidiDispatcher.
